sentences.text: Researchers investigated the cellular mechanisms of facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy, a neuromuscular condition driven by the inappropriate activation of the DUX4 gene in muscle tissue.
The study found that the DUX4 protein triggers an immune response that mimics a viral infection but operates independently of the standard type I interferon pathway.
This abnormal immune state is primarily driven by interferon-gamma signaling, which explains why inflammation in the disease does not resolve on its own.
In experimental models of the disease, blocking interferon-gamma reduced muscle inflammation and stopped the progression of the condition.
